items.title: Zimmer Biomet Holdings (ZBH) Just Jumped, What Is Behind The Move?
items.summary: Zimmer Biomet Holdings (ZBH) just delivered Q3 2026 results that topped revenue and adjusted EPS expectations, and management responded by lifting full year sales growth and earnings guidance, putting fresh focus on the stock. The market reaction has been swift. Zimmer Biomet Holdings has a 1-day share price return of 13.49% and a 7-day share price return of 14.28%, lifting the year-to-date share price return to 22.36% and contributing to a 27.16% 1-year total shareholder return. items.title: Zimmer Biomet (NYSE:ZBH) exceeds Q3 2026 expectations
items.summary: Medical device company Zimmer Biomet (NYSE:ZBH) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 3.1% year on year to $2.06 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.90 per share was 1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
